source.label: Artificial Analysis Core + listed benchmark extensions
source.methodologyNote: AIndex Scheme 18 takes the unweighted geometric mean of each board's complete Core percentages, then adds only positive residual evidence from listed independent-controller extension benchmarks under one anonymous dynamic cap. Five board scores contribute equally. Missing extensions stay absent and never reduce Core. Some extension operators, agent stacks, prompts, or versions remain mixed and are disclosed.

leaderboard.coreFit: unweighted geometric mean of direct percentages
leaderboard.missingPolicy: Core must be complete; missing extension observations stay absent, earn zero bonus, and never reduce Core.

calibration.missing_policy: core must be complete; missing extension is absent and earns zero bonus; no value is imputed
calibration.fit_apply_policy: fit OLS trends and shared cap once on the deduplicated population; apply unchanged to exact configurations

labels.rasch_equal_board: Unweighted continuous 1PL/Rasch point estimate; five boards equal
labels.twopl_equal_board: Unweighted continuous 2PL point estimate; five boards equal
labels.percentile_mean_equal_board: Equal item-percentile mean within board; five boards equal
labels.percentile_median_equal_board: Equal item-percentile median within board; five boards equal
labels.global_family_percentile: One equal vote per canonical benchmark family globally
labels.rasch_sparse_item_sensitivity: 1PL/Rasch sensitivity including benchmark items seen for at least 3 models
labels.rasch_dense_item_sensitivity: 1PL/Rasch sensitivity using benchmark items seen for at least 20 models
